headline: Fire & Ice Smoke Shop's tobacco permit to be revoked November 18th after fourth state law violation in 36 months
summary: The shop at 8 Boylston Street was issued a $5,000 citation. Earlier violations were on July 20th, 2023, April 22nd, 2025, and October 3rd, 2025. Staff reported flavored vape products for sale behind the counter during the November 4th inspection. The licensee cannot reapply for a permit at this address, and staff will check with the law department whether a new owner could take over the permit.
decisions: Approved revoking the tobacco permit for Fire & Ice Smoke Shop, 3-0.
Approved making the permit revocation effective November 18th, 2026, 3-0.
discussion: Repeat violations: Members said the four violations, two for sales to minors and two for flavored tobacco, show a pattern. Members also said other sales may have happened that were not caught.
Retailer notice: Members said communication was disjointed. Staff said the retailer was warned by phone and sent a letter dated November 12th, and the manager joined by phone during the meeting.
Public comment: Public speakers raised concerns about parking, litter, and sales to minors near the shop. Testimony was limited to the hearing topic.

Reapplication and revocation scope: The meeting heard that the licensee cannot reapply at this address, and a new owner might be able to buy the business, which staff would check. Members said the rules do not say what a revocation covers, and that could be reviewed later.

decision_evidence.quote: So, I would make a motion for the board to consider uh revocation of the permit at this point. ... So, the motion to revoke the permit carries uh with a majority of the uh board present and voting in favor of revocation.
I'll make a motion then to name November 18th as our date of permanent revocation. ... Joseph Paul, yes. Frances Anthes? Yes. Frances Anthes, yes. And Patrick Lowe, yes.
